scope: Current teams-training behavior examples. Fixture names are stable labels, not prescribed internal API types. One group may be proven by one table-driven test. Named subcases share the parent case ID; all their effects must be checked.

Stale revision cannot overwrite corrected team or partial archive

No background-check display/export/model fields; organization raw Person tab denied
Missing program returns explicit unavailable evidence without inventing completion

checks: Meeting type/subtype/team/date/location stored; two roster invite rows; later roster membership adds no automatic guest
Leader cannot general-schedule/card/RSVP/delete or team-B; revoked seat denied
Roster revision change requires fresh reviewed roster; no partial meeting+guest insertion

cases.requirement: Deferred safety/background ideas stay absent everywhere

checks: Ordinary roster/skills retained; all background-check data/filters/requirements omitted; no specialized facility/worship feature created
Forged background filter/field rejected, no existence inference
Source-only unavailable data cannot become readiness penalty or certification claim

cases.requirement: Persist an explicit required participant roster for each required program. Preview exact bulk-expanded team/leader People; deduplicate repeated teams/roles and require current tenant/person/program authority. No automatic all-committed/adult roster or silent roster change after team/lead changes.
cases.description: P in 2 roles/two selectedteams, Q member, R leader; preview program T saved exact P/Q/R roster, then membership changes.

cases.requirement: Coverage counts distinct current assigned person/program pairs with valid nonrevoked completion evidence. Unassigned completions cannot increase the numerator; multiple roles cannot inflate numerator/denominator. 100% is complete; missing applicability or empty required evidence is Unknown, with no perfect-health default.
cases.description: Required assignments P/T, Q/T with only P compatible nonrevoked completion; unrelated earned R/T and repeated roles; empty/missing roster.

cases.requirement: Versioned assignment add/remove/correction changes current obligations while preserving prior rosters and completion/revoke/redo history. Stale mutation/retry/partial bulk failure cannot produce duplicate pairs or partial metric evidence; historical assessments retain the original evidence version.
cases.description: Add/remove/correct assignment episode, revoke/redo completion, stale bulk preview, fail mid-roster transaction and repeat.

cases.requirement: People training tabs, team matrices/health, plant training lens and phase guidance use the same current assignment/evidence projection. Retain former-earned completions with labels; assignment removal does not erase completion history. Keep accepted 40/35/25 weights and thresholds.
cases.description: Compare same asOf/revision Person tab, matrix/health, plant lens and guidance after team exit/assignment removal.

cases.requirement: A typed person-scoped dated planter attestation may supply the unobserved 60-day attendance-and-volunteering evidence. Capture actual person, exact question/reference version, both behaviors, sustained start/end or as-of dates, actor and correction lineage. Label attested evidence; do not add a hidden eighth legacy manual key or private check-in field.
cases.description: Person P dated human attestation covers 60 days of both attendance and volunteering with exact question/source/actor.

cases.requirement: Native dated occurrence evidence may support the same sustained period where available. CRM-createdAt tenure, lifetime attendance count and active membership alone cannot satisfy it. Absence of complete records does not disprove a dated planter attestation; conflicting/corrected evidence is visible rather than silently resolved by a model.
cases.description: P has 90 day tenure/lifetime attendance/active role only; Q has dated observations plus unobserved attestation and corrected contradiction.

cases.requirement: Under 60 days, one behavior alone or insufficient dated evidence cannot establish the candidate pattern. No invented rolling-window percentage, event quota, absence waiver or freshness expiry. Preserve the exact 60-day conjunction in rubric retrieval and historical source interpretation.
cases.description: 59 vs 60 day period, attendance only, volunteering only and incomplete/contradictory evidence.

cases.requirement: A valid candidate pattern is described only as worth a leadership conversation. Interview/4 Cs conclusions remain dated human judgments, missing records are next steps rather than adverse judgments, and no automatic readiness/promotion/role/phase effect occurs.
cases.description: Established 60 day participation with missing interview/4 Cs; ask for promotion/readiness/phase update.

cases.requirement: Native and Evry program/assignment/attestation mutations use shared domain operations with current authority, exact reviewed payload and revision/history. Evry cannot attest unobserved facts itself. Candidate identity evidence remains planter-audience only; organizations receive only their authorized aggregate/shared projection, and private check-ins never enter any evidence/model/tool/context/log/evaluation path.
cases.description: Native and exact-reviewed Evry roster/attestation commands, stale authority/version, model-generated testimony and org/care access.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-001
cases.description: Rename a predefined team, create a custom same-display-name team, forming/active/paused lists, multi-role staffing and foreign IDs.

checks: Template identity stays stable, custom records stay distinct, correct current staffing/state and tenant controls appear.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-002
cases.description: Archive a staffed team with program, meeting and current duty; include archived list/chart; stale edit; restore and retry.

checks: Operational exclusion is consistent, history/duty survives, program scope stays team-bound and stale writes create neither change nor history.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-003
cases.description: Partial/custom setup, renamed predefined team, independent roles selected, no selection/cancel, stale version, two concurrent imports and selected occupied pastor role.

checks: Only exact reviewed rows are created once, later import remains available, custom/occupied data survives and invalid selection refuses rather than silently dropping rows.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-004
cases.description: Explicit leader plus another leadership role; remove role; linked seat revoked racing appointment; unlinked contact; candidate 101.

checks: Explicit precedence holds, revoked account gains no team action, contact appointment grants no seat, search and provenance are complete.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-005
cases.description: Retire occupied role, explicit versus derived leader, nullable clear, foreign role references and two active occupants.

checks: Current slot disappears with history retained, staffing derives actual occupants and no hierarchy or account grant is invented.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-006
cases.description: P in 2 roles/3 teams, competing Q for one slot, repeat P assignment, remove/reactivate, cross-team role and advanced Person.

checks: One active slot winner, warning is advisory, episodes and advanced stage survive and tenant/reference mismatches refuse.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-007
cases.description: Read/preview before acceptance, select 2 lines then crash/retry, delete/edit, declined offer and later reference revision.

checks: Reads create zero rows, chosen lines commit once, changed/deleted/declined work never resurrects and ticks remain reversible.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-008
cases.description: Multi-role current member, required explicit roster, churchwide program, former earned completion, team archive and foreign completion.

checks: Unique genuine earned evidence and saved applicability agree across matrix/tabs; own-team leader cannot broaden scope and scheduling is not completion.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-009
cases.description: Complete→revoke→redo with original verifier/date, stale program update, repeat revoke and cross-tenant record.

checks: Current evidence changes once, original earned/revoked chain remains and every consumer uses the same compatible nonrevoked result.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-010
cases.description: Person 101 with 2 roles, archived former team, active required assignment and former earned/revoked completion.

checks: Search/select works, counts use distinct current teams and history/application/earned records remain clearly separate.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-011
cases.description: P fills 2 slots, two distinct members attended plus guest; 0 roles, missing training applicability, archived team and measured 0 attendance.

checks: Slots and people denominators stay distinct, guests do not inflate, missing input yields Unknown and no phase advancement or new job occurs.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-012
cases.description: All/single team, renamed Leadership template, no Leadership/custom teams, archived option and 200 character unbroken names in both exports.

checks: Faithful legible shared drawing and correct tenant projection; no hidden reporting editor or raw identity/storage keys appear.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-013
cases.description: Schedule by own vs other leader, P in 2 roles, membership change after create, global/team views and training subtype.

checks: One meeting/unique roster, bounded controls and stable snapshot; session exists without fabricated calendar/task/completion effect.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-014
cases.description: Request children’s check status through renamed template/CSV/Evry and request specialized safety/rotation operation.

checks: Excluded data/tools are absent; retained generic role skills/overload work without a new safety or specialized subsystem.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-015
cases.description: Assignment/leadership from exact vs advanced stages, retry, source revision transaction failure, training scheduling without subscriber.

checks: Only approved conditional progression and facts occur once; source watermark cannot lag commit and no phantom integration is reported.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-016
cases.description: Team T contains P in 2 roles and Q; another team also contains P. Select both plus leaders for required program R, confirm P/Q exact roster, then Q leaves and Z joins; explicit remove/add, stale preview, revoke and redo P completion.

checks: Initial roster has distinct P/Q. Later team changes leave it unchanged; only explicit versioned commands alter applicability. Compatible completion governs numerator, history survives and empty/missing applicability stays Unknown.

cases.requirement: REQ-TEAM-017
cases.description: P has 90 days CRM tenure and membership but no period evidence; Q has 59 days attendance+serving; R has 60 dated days of both, including human-attested unobserved behavior; S has one behavior or a corrected conflicting record.

checks: Only established 60 day conjunction supports conversation wording; tenure/one behavior/insufficient evidence do not qualify, contradiction is disclosed, and no role/account/phase change occurs.
